title: NebulaMind Paper: The z≈9–10 Unlensed Metallicity Deficit
description:
Five unlensed z≈9.3–9.9 galaxies show a gas-phase metallicity deficit of about 0.7 dex relative to local galaxies at the same stellar mass. This explainer covers the sample, anchor swap, independent stacked cross-check, and the absolute Te-scale systematic.

Read the manuscript: https://nebulamind.net/studies/z9-10-unlensed-metallicity-deficit.pdf
